content: Model IDs (June 2026 official): claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (alias: claude-haiku-4-5) — / per MTok input/output, 200k context, fastest, Feb 2025 cutoff. claude-sonnet-4-6 — /5 per MTok, 1M context, fast, Aug 2025 cutoff. claude-opus-4-8 — /5 per MTok, 1M context, moderate speed. Haiku 4.5 minimum cache tokens 4,096. Sonnet 4.6 minimum cache 1,024. All support prompt caching (cache hit = 0.1x base price). For cheap-summary use Haiku 4.5; for deep contextual analysis use Sonnet 4.6.
